moments.title: The Triangle: An Underpriced Startup Hub
moments.insight: Austin argues the Research Triangle is one of the most underpriced, undertapped startup ecosystems in the country.

moments.title: Why He Built Bull House
moments.insight: Founders often don't realize they can headquarter their startup in the Triangle instead of leaving for coastal cities.

moments.title: Syllaby's Origin Story
moments.insight: He built Syllaby to automate the exact pain points—content ideas, scripting, editing—that made clients hire his old marketing agency.

moments.title: Post-AI: In-Person Is Making a Comeback
moments.insight: As AI automates work and frees up time, people are craving in-person connection again, driving his co-working concept.

moments.title: Why He Quit Agency Life for SaaS
moments.insight: Agency work became an emotional rollercoaster of feast-or-famine revenue and constant mental context-switching across clients.

moments.title: "It's Basically Illegal": AI UGC Take
moments.insight: He calls AI-generated fake product reviews unethical and an FTC violation, predicting heavy fines for brands that use them.
